How the employment mix at the origin of a commute relates, through the product
space, to the mix at its destination.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")
sys.path.append(".")

import os
import pandas as pd

from data_processing import load_and_prepare_data
from complexity import load_employment, compute_binary_rca, compute_proximity

SKIP_SECTORS = {"Other", "NA", "Agriculture"}
from relatedness import (
    employment_shares,
    dominant_sector,
    relatedness_for_flows,
    sector_profiles,
)
from si_plots import plot_sector_crosscity
```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = "../../figs/SI"
os.makedirs(FIGS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]

CITY_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": ("../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson", "../../data/bay_flows_h3_8.csv",
                 "../../data/workers_bay.csv"),
    "Los Angeles": ("../../data/h3_la_8.geojson", "../../data/la_flows_h3_8.csv",
                    "../../data/workers_la.csv"),
    "Mexico City": ("../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson", "../../data/cdmx_flows_h3_8.csv",
                    "../../data/workers_cdmx.csv"),
    "Rio de Janeiro": ("../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson",
                       "../../data/rio_flows_h3_8h3.csv",
                       "../../data/workers_rio.csv"),
}
```

## Relatedness of Every Observed Commute

```{python}
profiles = {}

for city, (zone_path, flow_path, employment_path) in CITY_PATHS.items():
    flows, *_ = load_and_prepare_data(zone_path, flow_path, city)
    flows["home_geomid"] = flows["home_geomid"].astype(str)
    flows["work_geomid"] = flows["work_geomid"].astype(str)

    employment = load_employment(employment_path)
    employment = employment[~employment["naics"].isin(SKIP_SECTORS)]
    shares = employment_shares(employment)
    proximity = compute_proximity(compute_binary_rca(employment))

    flows["sr"], flows["cosine"] = relatedness_for_flows(flows, shares, proximity)
    profiles[city] = sector_profiles(flows, dominant_sector(shares))

    covered = flows["sr"].notna().mean() * 100
    print(f"{city:16s} {len(flows):7,} pairs, {covered:5.1f}% with relatedness, "
          f"{len(profiles[city]):2d} sectors")
```

## Within-Sector Commuting across Cities

```{python}
fig = plot_sector_crosscity(profiles, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/comment3_sector_crosscity.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```
